name: Mexican Sativa
summary: Mexican Sativa is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] from [[country:MX|Mexico]], one of the four traditional parents usually named for [[haze|Haze]]. Most histories describe it only as a generic Mexican sativa, though some name it specifically as [[acapulco-gold|Acapulco Gold]]. Which population was actually used is not documented.

sources.title: The Strains That Shaped Cannabis Culture: Haze
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: this breeder page names Acapulco Gold as the specific Mexican parent, rather than a generic Mexican sativa.
